title: XTRA Gunpowder
description: With nothing but Sand and Charcoal, you make your gunpowder woes disappear!
body:
When obtaining Gunpowder is such a chore go with XTRA Gunpowder Mod as your first choice!, with nothing but Sand and Charcoal, you make your gunpowder woes disappear!

Created this for my CO-OP world with a friend who complained about how annoying killing Creepers Were.
